visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing a beige striped short-sleeved shirt and a young woman in a white T-shirt sit on a light grey couch in a modern living room, smiling and talking directly to the camera with high energy. (2) The scene cuts to the couple sitting at a low wooden round table; the man is on a grey ottoman and the woman is on the floor, both writing in journals. (3) Close-up shot of the man's hand writing in a journal with a black pen, showing neat Traditional Chinese characters. (4) The camera shows a montage of their shared activities: first, a POV shot of hands holding a bag of green vegetables at a market, then a close-up of a bunch of yellow bananas held in front of a fruit stall. (5) Transition to the couple standing in a park with bicycles; the woman wears a plaid shirt and a black cap, the man is in a black tank top. (6) A series of shots shows them cycling on a paved path surrounded by green trees, then through a busy urban street with storefronts. (7) Quick cuts show them running on a track at dusk, dancing together in their living room, and hiking in a lush green forest. (8) Return to the couch where they continue their conversation, gesturing with their hands. (9) A graphic overlay appears with the logo of Fubon Financial and photos of groups of people in blue t-shirts participating in 'Run For Green' tree-planting events. (10) A text document about 'GREEN HOUR' is displayed clearly on screen. (11) A screen recording of the Instagram profile '@fubon_ig' is shown, with a cursor clicking the 'Follow' button. (12) Finally, the couple on the couch waves goodbye and playfully falls backward together.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The primary indoor setting is a clean, modern living room with a grey sofa, a wooden coffee table, a shelf with wine bottles, and framed art on the wall. Outdoor settings include a vibrant vegetable market, a green city park, an urban street with shops, and a wooded hiking trail.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an upbeat, rhythmic acoustic guitar-driven pop track. A male and female voice speak simultaneously with high energy and brightness, introducing the topic of relationship secrets. (2) The female voice takes the lead, explaining the habit of gratitude journaling; her tone is warm and conversational. A subtle 'pop' SFX marks a visual transition. (3) The male voice continues the narrative, discussing the importance of consistent shared time. Occasional background ambient hum suggests field recording layers during the bicycle montage, but the studio-clean narration remains dominant. (4) A bright 'ding' SFX introduces the 'Green Hour' promotion. The tone shifts slightly towards a more professional, clear, and informative narrative style as they describe the Fubon Financial CSR event. (5) The BGM maintains a steady, happy tempo throughout. In the final phase, the voices become more playful and laughing as the couple waves goodbye, ending with the music fading out alongside their cheers.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct mention of Fubon Financial, display of their logo and CSR campaign details, and a call to action to follow their Instagram page.
